config.name: Shikoku Henro: Temples 1-23
config.description: The first prefecture of the Shikoku 88 temple pilgrimage, walked clockwise from Temple 1 Ryozenji at Naruto to Temple 23 Yakuoji at Hiwasa: the Yoshino river plain, the mountain crossing to Temple 12 Shosanji, Tokushima city, the climbs to Temples 20 and 21, and the coast road south. Built from a personal CalTopo map with pilgrim huts, Henro Houses, temple lodgings, campgrounds and onsen within 3 km of the route; scripts/process-shikoku-caltopo.ts turns the map's export into the GPX. The out-and-back from Temple 12 to its Okunoin on the summit of Mt Shosanji is a side trip, not part of the route distance.

dataSource.text: Track, accommodation and rest areas from a personal CalTopo map of the Shikoku 88 temples; Temples 3-9 and the Shosanji Okunoin positioned from OpenStreetMap.

waypoints.description:
ZENKONYADO - Free/donation (~¥500)
溝渕工業善根宿
Small shed on Pref Rd 12, ~1.1km SW of T5 Jizoji toward T6. Sleeps 3-4; power, kettle, fan, blankets, toilet. No bath (Yoshinogawa Onsen ~2km). First-come, no reservation. On the road route - easy to miss if you take the old Buyo-kaido. Can ask about it at T5.
Source: pilgrim-shikoku.net/mizobuchiindustry-freelodging; yamap.com/moments/752614 (2023)

waypoints.name: Kamojima Onsen Iyashi-no-Ya
waypoints.description:
ZENKONYADO - Free (onsen ¥360 pilgrim price, laundry ¥200)
鴨島温泉「鴨の湯」いやしの舎
Two weather-sealed pilgrim huts at municipal Kamojima Onsen, between T10 and T11 - classic last stop before the Shosanji climb. Register at onsen desk with photo ID. 1 night max, no fires; tents OK if huts full. Onsen 10:30-22:00, closed 3rd Thu. Tel 0883-22-1926. CAUTION: one 2023 report said huts closed at the time - PHONE AHEAD.
Source: pilgrim-shikoku.net; yamap.com/moments/752614; city.yoshinogawa.lg.jp (2023)

--- research (2022): Free / Unmanned hut at Ryusui-an, halfway on the T11→T12 Shosanji mountain crossing (~8km from Fujiidera). Electricity, spring water, toilet. CAVEAT: posted notice says overnight only in emergencies - pilgrims do sleep here but not officially sanctioned. Cold/exposed. Tent alternative ~4km on at Ipponsugi-an yamaban-goya (34.00759,134.30514).
Source: mititabi.com 2022 nojuku survey; henroseika.exblog.jp; OSM

--- research (2024): Free (unofficial) / Roadside station ~700m from T23 Yakuoji. Free pilgrim footbath, toilets, water. Informal overnight: discreet corner AFTER closing, no open tent, gone early. Not officially permitted - check for signs. Do NOT camp at nearby Ohama beach (loggerhead turtle nesting, light restrictions).
Source: mititabi.com 2022; michinoekihiwasa.com; ohenro.jp etiquette article 2024
